description: One store→customer mapping row for Connector Settings (spec 006, F-009 closure). The 012 work-item carries no customer; the operator maps each store to its ERPNext Customer. Consumed by connector.posting.config.parse_store_customer_map (fieldnames store_id/customer must match the parser). A store with no row fails closed (UnmappedStore → validation) — the connector never fabricates a customer (Principle VI).

fields.label: ERPNext Customer
fields.description: The ERPNext Customer that sales from this store post against.

name: RT Store Customer Map Row
